info.title: Hacker News Search API (Algolia)
info.description: Public, keyless read-only search over the full Hacker News archive, powered by Algolia. Provides keyword search across stories and comments, with relevance ranking (/search) or reverse-chronological ordering (/search_by_date), plus time and type filtering. Complements the official Firebase Hacker News API, which offers item/list browsing but no keyword search.

servers.description: Algolia-hosted Hacker News search index (public, no authentication).

get.description: Full-text keyword search over Hacker News stories and comments, ordered by a relevance ranking that combines textual match, points, and recency. Use the `tags` parameter to restrict the result type (e.g. only stories, only comments, only Ask HN) and `numericFilters` to bound by time or popularity.

200.description: A page of matching Hacker News items.

get.description: Same full-text search as /search, but results are ordered strictly by descending creation date rather than relevance. Preferred for freshness sweeps where the most recent matching stories or comments are wanted regardless of popularity.

200.description: A page of matching Hacker News items, newest first.

BadRequest.description: The request parameters were malformed (for example an invalid `numericFilters` expression).

status.description: HTTP status code echoed by Algolia.

Query.name: query
Query.description: Full-text search query. Matched against story titles, story text, comment text, URLs, and authors.

Tags.name: tags
Tags.description: Filter by item type and/or association. Comma-separated values are AND-ed; values wrapped in parentheses are OR-ed, e.g. `(story,poll)`. Common tags: `story`, `comment`, `poll`, `pollopt`, `show_hn`, `ask_hn`, `front_page`, `author_<username>` (items by an author), `story_<id>` (items belonging to a story).

NumericFilters.name: numericFilters
NumericFilters.description: Comma-separated numeric comparisons applied to `created_at_i` (Unix seconds), `points`, or `num_comments`. Operators: `<`, `<=`, `=`, `>`, `>=`. Example: `created_at_i>1700000000,points>10`.

Page.name: page
Page.description: Zero-based page number of results to return.

HitsPerPage.name: hitsPerPage
HitsPerPage.description: Number of results per page (Algolia caps this; typical maximum is 1000).

hits.description: The matching items on this page.

nbHits.description: Total number of matches across all pages.

page.description: Zero-based index of the returned page.

hitsPerPage.description: Results per page for this response.

query.description: The query string that was executed.

params.description: The URL-encoded parameter string Algolia applied.

Hit.description: A Hacker News story or comment. Story fields (title, url, num_comments) are present on story hits; comment fields (comment_text, story_title, story_url, parent_id) are present on comment hits.

objectID.description: Hacker News item id (matches the Firebase item id).

created_at_i.description: Creation timestamp as Unix seconds (used by numericFilters).

points.description: Score of the item (stories/polls; null for comments).

title.description: Story or poll title (null on comment hits).

url.description: External URL of the story (null when it is a text post or a comment).

num_comments.description: Comment count on the story (null on comment hits).

story_id.description: Id of the story this item belongs to.

comment_text.description: HTML body of the comment (present only on comment hits).

story_title.description: Title of the parent story (present on comment hits).

story_url.description: URL of the parent story (present on comment hits).

parent_id.description: Id of the parent item for a comment.

children.description: Ids of direct child comments, when present.

_tags.description: Algolia tags on the item (e.g. story, author_pg, story_12345).
